structured_output.rationale: Lines 1-2 paid normally (CO-45 contractual, PR-2 coinsurance = routine AR). Line 3 is the denial: CO-151 + N362 = MUE units exceeded. Chart note documents only 31 timed minutes of 97112, supporting 2 units not the 5 billed — a keying/quantity error, correctable regardless of MAI tier. Part B FFS does not accept frequency 7, so the vehicle is a clerical-error reopening.

root_cause.explanation: 835 line 3: 97112-GP, 5 units, CO-151 with N362 (units exceed acceptable maximum), $214.95 denied in full. Chart note documents 31 minutes of 97112 — supports 2 units, not 5.

next_action.detail: File a clerical-error reopening with Novitas on line 3 only, correcting 97112-GP from 5 units to 2 units. Do not send frequency 7 — Part B FFS rejects it. Do not appeal; do not bill the patient (group CO).

evidence.fact: 97112-GP 5 units denied $214.95 under CO-151 with RARC N362
97112 documented at 31 minutes, supporting 2 timed units; total timed minutes 60
CO-151+N362 is the MUE signature; keying/quantity error → correct_and_resubmit; never bill patient (CO)

citations.rule: CO-151 + N362 = MUE exceeded; excess units from a keying error are corrected and resubmitted, never billed to the patient.
Medicare Part B FFS does not accept CLM05-3 = 7; use a clerical-error reopening.
CO on a Medicare FFS (MB) remit is never billable to the patient.
